fields.label: Active
fields.description: Only active Masters can be selected for new cards, demand, and replenishment cycles.

fields.label: BOM
fields.description: Required for Production control. Use an active submitted BOM with operations when Job Cards are expected.

fields.label: Control Type
fields.description: Production creates manufacturing demand; Withdrawal replenishes point-of-use material; Transfer moves stock between warehouses.

fields.label: Card Representation
fields.description: Unit identifies one piece; Batch represents a replenishment lot; Container represents the standard quantity held in one tote, pallet, or bin.

fields.label: Replenishment Qty
fields.description: Quantity represented by one Kanban Card or one demand cycle. This is separate from ERPNext safety stock and reorder level.

fields.label: Number of Cards
fields.description: Number of reusable cards in this loop. Do not use this to represent parallel Job Cards; parallel workstations are configured inside Operation Profiles.

fields.label: Automation Level
fields.description: Automatic releases ERP actions immediately; Approval waits for a manager; Signal Only records demand without creating ERP documents. Use Approval during rollout.

fields.label: Default Priority
fields.description: Default scheduling priority for new signals. Urgent should be reserved for genuinely expedited demand.

fields.label: Allow Partial Output
fields.description: Allows good quantity to be reported before the full Cycle quantity is complete. Actual downstream release still follows each operation's handoff and start rules.

fields.label: Use ERP BOM Operations
fields.description: Keeps ERPNext BOM operations as the manufacturing route and Job Card source. Recommended because ERPNext remains the system of record.

fields.label: Operation Profiles
fields.description: Configure execution, readiness, reporting, and handoff behaviour for every controlled BOM operation.

fields.label: Operator Field Definitions
fields.description: Adds operation-specific checks or measurements to the Operator progress dialog.
